'''Arago Tanca''' was an [[Gender/Legends|male]] outlaw tech that specialized in designing and building extreme structures. He had years of experience in zero-g and [[Vacuum/Legends|hard-vacuum]] construction. He would hire himself out to any customer and avoided discussing his personal feelings on any job. He was often used to build asteroid bases.<ref name="H&S" />

Tanca was extremely secretive. He would not divulge his thoughts on politics or beliefs nor give out any specifics on jobs he had done in the past. If pressed, he would get upset and quit.<ref name="H&S" />
